instruction: Extract audio track from a video as MP3
Replace audio track in a video with a new audio file
Add a second audio track as a stereo mix
output: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -i audio.mp3 -map 0:v -map 0:a -map 1:a -c copy -metadata:s:a:1 language=eng output.mp4

instruction: Remove audio from a video
Extract a specific audio track by index
Downmix 5.1 audio to stereo
Normalize audio volume using loudnorm
Add subtitles to a video from an SRT file
output: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -i subtitles.srt -c copy -c:s mov_text output.mp4

instruction: Burn subtitles into the video permanently
Extract subtitles from MKV as SRT
Add metadata title to a video file
output: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -metadata title='My Video' -c copy output.mp4

instruction: Set metadata artist and description
output: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -metadata artist='John Doe' -metadata comment='Shot in 2025' -c copy output.mp4

instruction: Remove all metadata from a video
Change language metadata on the audio stream
Extract chapter metadata from MKV
Set a cover art image on an MP4 file
output: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -i cover.jpg -map 0 -map 1 -c copy -disposition:v:1 attached_pic output.mp4

instruction: Add multiple audio tracks from separate files
output: ffmpeg -i video.mp4 -i audio_eng.flac -i audio_spa.flac -map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a -c copy -metadata:s:a:0 language=eng -metadata:s:a:1 language=spa output.mp4

instruction: Extract all audio streams preserving codec
Convert audio codec to Opus while copying video
Delay audio by 500ms to sync with video
Merge audio and video from separate files
output: ffmpeg -i video.mp4 -i audio.wav -c:v copy -c:a aac output.mp4
